versions.content: Error Name: EEP_E_COMPARE_FAILED Short Description: EEPROM compare failed (HW) Long Description: The Eeprom module reports this error when EEPROM compare job fails due to a hardware error. Fail EEPROM compare job failed (see [SWS_Eep_00253]). Detection Criteria: Pass EEPROM compare job finished successfully (see [SWS_Eep_00254]). Secondary Parameters: N/A Time Required: N/A Monitor Frequency: Implementation specific
